_comment: 参考用。実運用の一覧は repos_mapping.local.json (gitignore)
$schema-hint: Master list of all claude-rules-* repos and which CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR each one owns. scripts/rules.sh (just rules-*) reads this to decide where to symlink for-me/for-others/for-all layers. 'pluginOnlyHomes' lists CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIRs that get no rules layers, only the listed plugins (scripts/plugins.sh, via `just plugins-*`, checks/installs/updates them; 'marketplaces' maps a marketplace name to owner/repo for `marketplace add` — omit entries that are registered by the tool itself, e.g. ccmsg's directory marketplace).
